about: Owner decision list D4 of the audit-fix spec (T3 item 2): every result that leaves `generatable` against dbc5eeb or 7345490f needs an owner decision. Proposals from benchmarks/t3/evidence.md; owner_decision stays null until the owner decides, and the executor never fills it. benchmarks/t3/tools/acceptance_compare.py separates a described transition (an entry matches) from an approved one (decision_format below) and lists every pending row with its exact key in the `d4_pending_rows` of its JSON report.

decision_format.owner_decision: null (pending) or {"decision": "accept" | "reject", "candidate_library_sha256": <64 hex of the accepted candidate>, "rows": [{"corpus", "file", "tokenizer", "outcome"}], "by": <name>, "date": <YYYY-MM-DD>, "note": <text>}
decision_format.approval: a transition row is approved only when its entry has decision accept, the decision names the candidate's library sha256 (the same hash in both corpora), and `rows` lists the row with the exact corpus, file, tokenizer and candidate outcome; a wildcard is never a row. An entry with requires_triage_class needs, in addition, that row's class in the T2c triage of the same candidate (benchmarks/triage_semantic.py --out-json) with every invalid document present and checked.
decision_format.candidate: candidate_library_sha256 above names the candidate the proposals were written for; a comparison with another candidate reports every decision as not applicable

derived_from.note: every entry re-checked on 6e62e0d1; the earlier text of a changed entry is kept under `previous`

groups.pass1_budget_edge: incomplete results whose only line pass that completed is pass 1, the greedy policy pass, which checks its 10 s budget at steps 16, 32, 48, ...; the candidate recorded the time limit at the first check it failed. R11-A replays pass 1 on five libraries with the run's harness, tokenizers and schemas on one quiet P-core (3 rounds, rotated order; the rule fixed before the run in R11_PLAN.md): the pass-1 document is the same on every library in 27 of 27 results; the candidate is 9.6 % slower than its own source built for the host CPU (median over 27 results, 27 of 27 slower, noise 2.9 %), the code of the release line is not (native/50cbd80e 0.993). The release recipe builds with -Dcpu=baseline (unchanged since dbc5eeb: .github/workflows/release.yml), the lines' libraries were host builds. On a quiet core the candidate completes pass 1 within 10 s in 26 of 27 results (every library the same); in the R6 run (8 jobs) 50cbd80e, a host build with the same harness, completed pass 1 in 12 repository results of this group where the candidate did not.
groups.expensive_pass1: kb_1154: pass 1 costs about 1 s per fill on every library and exceeds 10 s at step 16 on every library with the run's harness (R2b, R11-A).
groups.engine_unavailable: byte-level RESOURCE_LIMIT passes: R11-C replays every one on the candidate with the recorded seed and 10 s and reproduces outcome, stage, code, step and prefix; the undecided reasons are listed per entry.
groups.invalid_document: D4-6, the T2c class D rule.
groups.no_transition: D4-1, D4-2r, D4-7, D4-8, D4-9: kept for the record.
